Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in the initial analysis by incorrectly stating that Dario Franchitti competed in the DTM/ITC series in the "mid-1990s" (specifically citing 1994–1996) for the Mercedes team in Affalterbach. In reality, Dario Franchitti's contract with Mercedes-AMG (Affalterbach) was signed in **2007**, and he competed in the **Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters (DTM)** series starting from the **2008** season. The mid-1990s driver for Mercedes in that series was Bernd Schneider. By anchoring the search on the wrong decade (1990s), the Planner caused the WebSurfer to retrieve irrelevant historical data about the wrong driver (Schneider) or misinterpreted early Franchitti career details, leading to the completely incorrect final answer of "International Touring Car Championship (ITC) in 1996."
